privacy.note: Aggregate counts only. Verify parcel-level details in county sources and the private dashboard.

totals.countywide_tax_status_note: Current Tax Due from the county's November 8 combined-file snapshot, verified against its official layout. Excludes older-year delinquent balances, interest and other charges; not a live countywide lookup.
totals.delinquent_tax_status_note: Separate older-year Delinquent Tax Due field from November 8; counts can overlap current-year balances. These are not freshly verified redemption quotes and exclude separate interest and other charges.
totals.due_soon_note: Unavailable: the source snapshot does not supply verified installment due dates for every parcel.
totals.annual_tax_total_basis: Retained legacy scoring input, not an independently verified sum of current taxes billed. Scoring inputs are unchanged by this balance correction.

payment_correction.note: Corrected the combined-file field mapping using the county's official layout. Current Tax Due is its own field; current credits/debits and historical delinquent tax billed are not installment-payment pairs. The November 8 snapshot contains 172 countywide current-tax balances, including 10 in the target area. Earlier figures of 311 countywide and 36 target-area balances were unreliable. This is a calculation correction, not newly unpaid taxes or evidence of new payments. Older-year delinquent taxes, interest and other charges are separate.

payment_reconciliation.coverage_note: The 41 records flagged by the old calculation were checked directly on November 16. All current balances match the corrected November 8 snapshot to the cent: 10 positive and 31 zero. This was not a fresh review of all 109,837 county parcels or all 22,707 target-area parcels. Zero current balance does not establish that older-year taxes, interest or other charges are clear.
payment_reconciliation.historical_note: The old 41 count mixed incompatible file fields. The published 36 came from the old pipeline, which was configured to check up to 1,000 records online; its individual changes cannot be reconstructed from the retained evidence. Neither is treated as a verified current-balance count, and the 31 zeros are not claimed as new payments.

scoring_provenance.note: Scores retain the reviewed November 8, 2026 tax snapshot. generated_at is export time, not a new county record date. GIS retrieval time is not the county attribute update date; payment-timing fields may have separate refresh dates.
